stage: Added after inspection of the 60,000-attempt-per-arm diagnostic and before completion or BBC analysis of the 120,000-attempt-per-arm campaign.
finding: Released native BBC derives each field-group redshift map origin and extent from DATA. Arm-specific selection can therefore change map geometry even with identical nominal correction training. The 60k diagnostic also retains only high-mass hosts, making free gamma degenerate with the global zero point.
selected_input_estimand: Retain the original selected-input pipeline contrast. Label frozen_nominal as frozen nominal TRAINING and fitted nuisance parameters, with native selection-dependent map geometry. Refitted-minus-frozen on the same age_nominal output still isolates nuisance refitting exactly.
additional_common_cohort: Restrict both evaluation inputs to the identical intersection of pre-BBC quality/classifier occurrence IDs; assert identical per-field observed zHD lists. Run all four unchanged native 4336 cases. Assert nominal and age_nominal native map bounds, cell dimensions and NBIASCOR_CUTS match. This is a fixed-support sensitivity, not a replacement for the selection response.
identifiability_audit: Audit scaled [x1,c,host-step, native-bin intercept] design rank and its null directions. Gamma unidentifiable solely along a global zero point does not mathematically invalidate centered shapes, but is never called a measured mass step or full nuisance recovery. Preserve BAD_OUTPUT/CrazyERR/bound warnings and fail closed on reported free-nuisance slopes when rank or native covariance output fails. A separately labeled gauge-fixed diagnostic may be assessed only if its scientific assumptions are explicit.
covariance: Native .COV is the raw fitted-bin Hesse covariance with large placeholders for unfitted bins, used with a free global normalization. It is not the exactly centered M0DIF covariance. The attempt bootstrap reports a separate centered-bin covariance and paired estimand differences.
unchanged: No photon, truth, selection, native scientific minimum-count, field grouping, alpha/beta map-construction or interpolation thresholds are changed. Only the already disclosed native capacity bug patch is permitted.

fixed_nuisance_conditional_control.method: Separate --common --fixed native runs set u1=u2=u5=0 and p5=0 while preserving source p1=.15,p2=2.87, same trained-map construction, all scientific support gates and identical common evaluation inputs. This measures map-target response conditional on fixed standardization, not successful nuisance retraining.
fixed_nuisance_conditional_control.bootstrap: If effective common slope sample is at least30 with at least10/bin, run200 joint and100 training-only paired attempt replicates. Preserve the original free-nuisance failed gate separately.
